The '''Model 40 Marksman Scope''' was a model of telescopic optical [[Scope/Legends|sight]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was manufactured by [[Zikon Optics]] and sold for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
